bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; requiring a parent or legal guardian to be present for vaccine administration to a minor; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 145.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[145.673] VACCINES ADMINISTERED TO MINORS; PARENT OR LEGAL GUARDIAN PRESENCE. +]

[+(a) A health care provider may administer a vaccine to a minor only if the minor's parent or legal guardian is present when the vaccine is administered. +]

[+(b) Paragraph (a) does not apply to a vaccine to which the minor consented according to section 144.341, 144.342, or 144.3441. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; requiring a parent or legal guardian to be present for vaccine administration to a minor; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 145.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[145.673] VACCINES ADMINISTERED TO MINORS; PARENT OR LEGAL GUARDIAN PRESENCE.

(a) A health care provider may administer a vaccine to a minor only if the minor's parent or legal guardian is present when the vaccine is administered.

(b) Paragraph (a) does not apply to a vaccine to which the minor consented according to section 144.341, 144.342, or 144.3441.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: [145.673] VACCINES ADMINISTERED TO MINORS; PARENT OR LEGAL GUARDIAN PRESENCE.
(a) A health care provider may administer a vaccine to a minor only if the minor's parent or legal guardian is present when the vaccine is administered.
(b) Paragraph (a) does not apply to a vaccine to which the minor consented according to section 144.341, 144.342, or 144.3441.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
